source_refs.note: Nociceptors: a main subheading of 15.6.3 Receptors of Pain & Touch, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 45-45.

blocks.text: Nociceptors dard pakarte hain. Dard ko aise stimulus ke taur par bayan kiya gaya hai jo tissue ko nuqsan pohancha raha ho ya pohanchane wala ho. Nociceptors free nerve endings hain jo poore jism mein, khaas taur par sateh ke qareeb, hote hain. Mukhtalif nociceptors shadeed darja-e-hararat, bohat tez dabao ya khaas kimiyai maddon (jin mein zakhmi cells se nikalne wale madde bhi hain) par jawab de sakte hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Thermoreceptors sensory neurons ke nange (naked) dendrite sire hain. Yeh darja-e-hararat ka girna aur barhna pakarte hain. Thand ke receptors epidermis ke bilkul neeche hain, jabke garmi ke receptors thora gehre, dermis mein hain.
Thermoreceptors dimagh ke hypothalamus mein bhi hain, jahan yeh khoon ka darja-e-hararat pakar kar jism ke andaruni (core) darja-e-hararat par nazar rakhte hain.
